# [Trading,Scripts,Routing,Config,Frontend] fix(cron): set symbol column on trade insert

Tick engine was inserting trades with trading_pair set but symbol
left NULL. This broke analytics that query symbol directly from DB.

- Add symbol: pair.replace('/', '') to trade insert in cron/tick
- Backfill: UPDATE trades SET symbol = trading_pair WHERE NULL

All 1476 trades now have symbol populated.
